composition_missions.task: For AtlasOps, build a competitively ready organic asset for the intent 'field service scheduling software for multi-location teams'. First establish enough current search/competitor evidence to understand the opportunity and what strong current leaders are doing. Then translate that evidence into complete SEO/AEO content requirements and use those requirements to produce the actual customer-facing article/page asset through Content Synthesis. Reuse the same evidence, conclusions, and requirements rather than rediscovering the strategy at each step. Persist an Opportunity, Insight, WorkRequest, or other durable coordination object only when it will materially improve continuity beyond the current capable model simply continuing the work. The final asset must visibly reflect the upstream requirements, receive appropriate content QA, preserve useful AURA state and evidence, and leave an appropriate measurement/recheck plan. Do not invent rankings, traffic, AI-answer citations, competitor performance, or tool use you cannot verify.

domain_missions.task: Take a supported business opportunity through the real work, resulting decision/action, outcome evaluation where evidence exists, and useful Learning where warranted. Preserve the decision rationale, material results, unresolved work, and useful continuity so another capable model or person can understand what happened and continue intelligently. Do the real work rather than describing an internal lifecycle.

Build a decision-grade current understanding of why qualified buyers hesitate, what they value, what they misunderstand, segment differences, switching triggers, objections, and desired outcomes. Use the supplied first-party evidence plus additional legitimate research where useful; persist reusable intelligence and identify actionable implications.

Establish the real competitive set and produce a decision-grade competitive position: offerings, pricing/packaging where observable, messaging, proof, funnels, customer sentiment, content/advertising patterns, strategic changes, strengths/weaknesses, whitespace, and evidence-calibrated tactic hypotheses. Treat visibility, engagement, repetition, and ad longevity as potentially useful market/attention/persistence signals when relevant, but do not upgrade them into proof of profitability or causal effectiveness without supporting evidence.

Determine what has materially changed in the market, technology, platform, regulatory, and buyer environment that could affect this business now. Triangulate current evidence, distinguish noise from durable change, assess applicability, and preserve or surface only the intelligence that is decision-relevant.

Identify the highest-value realistic organic-search and AI-answer opportunity for this business and execute the complete work needed to maximize the probability of winning it. Inspect the live SERP and relevant AI-answer surfaces, compare multiple leaders, understand why leaders may be winning, create or improve the actual required asset(s), perform technical/on-page/internal integration and QA, and leave a measurement/recheck plan. Do not claim ranking or citation before it occurs.

Turn one strong business Insight into a professional content package chosen for the intended audience and channels. Benchmark the relevant content field where useful, create the actual core and derivative assets rather than descriptions, ensure each is native to its medium, perform fact/brand/originality/accessibility QA, and prepare distribution and measurement.

Design and produce a competitive acquisition campaign for qualified demo bookings. Research current competitor advertising and persuasion patterns across appropriate ad transparency/creative surfaces and landing paths, calibrate performance proxies, use customer intelligence, then create the actual campaign assets, landing experience, variants, implementation-ready package, and measurement plan.

Diagnose the most commercially important current funnel/customer bottleneck from first-party evidence, distinguish symptom from likely cause, design the strongest justified intervention, create or coordinate the required implementation assets, define measurement, and preserve the decision and expected outcome without overstating causality.

cross_domain_missions.task: Increase qualified organic demo demand. Use whatever Customer, Competitor, Industry, SEO/AEO, Content, Marketing, and Customer Optimization work is actually warranted. The final work must be executable and competitively ready, not a recommendation report.

Create a defensible paid acquisition test that can outperform the current baseline. Combine customer evidence, competitor/ad-library intelligence, offer analysis, platform-native creative, landing experience, instrumentation, and measurement. Respect any real user, account, platform, legal, or business constraint on external execution, and produce the real assets available in the environment.

Qualified traffic is adequate but conversion is below target. Determine the real bottleneck, use customer and competitor evidence where relevant, create the highest-value intervention and supporting assets, and define how success will be measured.

A meaningful market/platform/competitor change has occurred. Detect it from the newly released supplied evidence and current research, determine whether it matters, update the business view, and execute any justified SEO/content/marketing/customer response without trend chasing.

Prepare a new offer launch end to end: customer/market/competitor grounding, positioning and offer, search/discovery plan, content, marketing assets, conversion path, QA, instrumentation, and post-launch learning plan. Respect real external constraints rather than inventing AURA permission machinery.

Assume leadership only says: improve this business profitably. Inspect the accumulated AURA state and current evidence, determine the highest-value work now, explain the decision briefly, then do the material work that can actually be completed now instead of stopping at a plan. Preserve the useful result, unresolved constraints, and next measurement or follow-up.

marathon_missions.task: Operate the benchmark business continuously through the entire qualification queue. Reuse accumulated context and evidence, do not reset between events, do not redo research without a reason, and keep canonical state coherent. Preserve uncertainty and do not assume future evidence before it is released.

Continue after the newly released later-period evidence arrives: campaign performance changes, a competitor change requires verification, new customer interviews appear, and earlier assumptions may no longer hold. Reprioritize, execute justified work, evaluate outcomes, and update Learning/process extensions where warranted without modifying canonical AURA source.
